explication: Qwen Code is an AI coding agent whose main workflow begins with a developer request, enters a CLI or another supported surface, runs an agent session, invokes tools and model providers, and returns streamed results while maintaining session state. The repository also supports MCP, skills, memory, browser automation, channels, ACP daemon clients, web tasks, extensions, and live audio. Several subsystem links are inferred from documented capabilities and tree structure; sampled source most directly confirms model streaming, storage, history, task polling, OAuth persistence, compaction, and audio playback.
